mappings.source: java.lang.M3StringMixedCompare.compareIgnoreCase / regionMatchesIgnoreCase: every differing unit pair folded through Character.toUpperCase/toLowerCase over 256-unit char windows (A10 lineage, carried to A27 8667149f77)
mappings.target: 4096-unit byte windows read in the content coder of each side (a flat side in place) handed to the stock StringLatin1/StringUTF16 compareToCI and regionMatchesCI families; the content coder is the coder a flat String of the same spelling carries (prepared facts, else a bulk scan with early exit); two UTF-16 sides keep surrogate pairs inside one window and take their difference from windows that reach one unit past the shorter side
mappings.status: implemented-locally-verified (G7; flag-off: M3IgnoreCaseWindowsTest 188,512 checks against the flat Strings; Latin-1 equalsIgnoreCase/regionMatches(ignoreCase) 4x..9x faster at 16384 units, 5x..11x at 65536, 2.5x..4x at 256..2048; UTF-16 at flat)
mappings.target_rule: the same boolean and the same compareToIgnoreCase value as the flat Strings

mappings.source: java.lang.M3StringAtom.getBytes with UTF-16 storage and a Latin-1 destination: one Unsafe.getChar and a narrowing store per unit (carried to 8667149f77)
mappings.target: from 64 units the units come out through a 4 KiB window and StringUTF16.compress narrows them; a window holding a unit above 0xff keeps the per-unit truncation
mappings.status: implemented-locally-verified (the lane behind the Latin-1 reads of wide-owner ranges in the case-insensitive comparisons)
mappings.target_rule: the same bytes as the per-unit loop

mappings.source: java.lang.String.regionMatches(int, String, int, int) and regionMatches(boolean, int, String, int, int) with an M3 side and len <= 0: the facts gate sliced the range or sized a window first and threw (carried to 8667149f77)
mappings.target: the M3 branches answer true first, as the stock loops do for a non-positive len
mappings.target_rule: the same boolean as the flat String
